notes.title: Our First Speedrunning Competition Starts NOW!
notes.content:
How quickly can you outrun the horrors that plague you?

Let’s hope it’s pretty fast, because our first ever Voidwrought speedrunning competition has just begun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/e5fb48c1f80e60e3a71c845fe66db5ccb8280a13.png

Our competition will be split between two categories, each with a different challenge level and prize pool.

Before we get into the cosmic prize pool on offer, we’d ask any prospective speedy Simulacrums to please read the competition rules carefully:

[olist]
 Players must use the Livesplit Timer on their videos to verify their times;
 Players must not revert back to older builds to play. They must play on the latest build available at the time of their run. Updates to the game may occur during the duration of the competition, so please update your build before recording your run;
 Players are permitted to abuse all game mechanics and glitches to get the lowest time;
 Players who edit their videos or try to cheat their time in any way will be immediately disqualified and ineligible to re-enter;
 Players can submit multiple runs throughout the competition for both categories. When the competition ends, only your fastest run for each category will be counted;
 All players can enter both categories;
 All entries will be verified by the developer and publisher team for Voidwrought before a winner is selected;
 Players must play on a brand new save file created when pressing 'New Journey' in the main menu to start the run. They cannot exploit any glitches that would allow them to play on an old save file, even if they have selected 'New Journey' in the process;
 For Category 1, players must defeat the Council Boss and get the Ledge Grab ability in the clip for it to qualify.
[/olist]

Now let’s take a look at the two categories you can enter, starting with…

Category 1 - The Council Boss Fight & Ledge Grab

Challenge Level: Beginner to Intermediate
Run Start: Time starts when selecting New Journey in the main menu. Players may skip through the opening cut-scene. 
Run End: Time ends when the player touches the Ledge Grab ability after defeating The Council boss.
1st Place Prize: £100 GBP (approx. $120 USD) Steam gift card
2nd Place Prize: £25 GBP (approx. $30 USD) Steam gift card

Category 2 - The Eternal Engine Boss Fight

Challenge Level: Intermediate to Advanced
Run Start: Time starts when selecting New Journey in the main menu. Players may skip through the opening cut-scene. 
Run End: Time ends when you defeat the Eternal Engine and the words “Herald Vanquished” appear on the screen. Time ends at the last input (i.e. the interact input to get the Ledge Grab ability).
1st Place Prize: £200 GBP (approx. $250 USD) Steam gift card
2nd Place Prize: £50 GBP (approx. $60 USD) Steam gift card

The challenge levels are only suggestions so, even if you are a beginner, we still encourage you to try entering both categories to see how quickly you can navigate our world of cosmic horrors!

To submit your run, all you need to do is follow the link here and upload your run for each category. You can either submit your run by uploading a video or by linking a YouTube video depending on what’s easier for you. 

The competition will end on Tuesday March 18th, so make sure you’ve submitted your run(s) before the deadline!

notes.title: New Game+ and Hardcore Mode Unleashed
notes.content:
Are you exterminating the Heralds and Progenitors with ease? Looking for more of a challenge on your cosmic horror adventures?

Then look no further!

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve added New Game+ and Hard Mode to Voidwrought for all of you skilled Simulacrums.

We’ve added not one, not two, but three New Game+ paths for you to enjoy!

Once you complete the main game, you’ll unlock all of the New Game+ paths. After defeating [spoiler]the Weeper[/spoiler], a New Game Plus Unlocked Message will appear on the screen to let you know that all of the paths have been unlocked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/cfb785abbe84923f6ff6adc0e5d8575384db6bf4.png

From there, you’ll need to go back to the main menu and then you’ll have the option to convert an eligible save file into a New Game+ profile. Your main path progression will reset, but you will retain the following regardless of which path you choose:

 Health upgrades
 Damage upgrades
 Relics
 Souls
 Void charges

So what are the 3 exciting New Game+ paths you can choose from?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/ab449f1d8eb9c96792a1887667ecb0a88a093993.png

The Reborn

For those of you who like a major combat challenge, the Reborn path might be the choice for you. On this path, enemy damage and enemy health have been increased, so you better be ready for a fight!

The Harbinger

If you’re a connoisseur of fine Relics, then the Harbinger might be the right path for you. On this path, enemy damage is increased and your regular attack damage is greatly reduced, but you have access to unlimited Void Charges so you can take full advantage of your Relic abilities at any time!

The Undone

This path is for those Simulacrums who love a lot of risk with their reward. On this path, death itself becomes a weapon. You permanently lose 1 health bar per death and you cannot regain health outside of dying, but your regular attack damage is increased every time you die. On top of that, enemy damage is increased, so you’ll need to carefully consider every hit you take and die tactically for the greatest advantage. 

If you revert your New Game+ save file on the Undone path or start a new path after finishing the Undone, the health penalty and damage increase will be reset.

Once a path has been chosen, you must complete that path and defeat [spoiler]the Weeper[/spoiler] before you can move on to another path using that save file. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/3e9d2c1b93804ac9c45c9a38d4b41738227e5658.png

Please note that you can revert your New Game+ save back to a main game save, but the following conditions will apply:

 Reverting will restore the save file back to the exact point just before it was converted into a New Game+ file;
 Reverting will erase all New Game+ progress made on that save file;
 Once a New Game+ save file has been reverted back to a main game save file, it cannot be undone;
 Reversion works in layers. For example, if you’ve completed all three New Game+ modes on one save file, you’ll need to revert three times in order to return to the normal game mode. 

Alongside the three New Game+ paths, we’ve also added Hardcore Mode to the game for any Simulacrum who yearns for an extra challenge, regardless of whether they’ve completed the game or not.

Hardcore Mode

When creating a new save, players can select the “Hardcore” option instead of the “Normal” option to enter Hardcore Mode without needing to have completed the game first. Please note that this cannot be changed once the save file has been created and you will not be able to revert to Normal difficulty on a Hardcore save file.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/f5fbb66a240f03e4ee5064514db52678b9ef9180.png

In Hardcore Mode, death is permanent and the save file is deleted upon death. It is important to note that, if you complete the game in Hardcore Mode and want to convert your save file into a New Game+ save file, the New Game+ save file will also be in Hardcore Mode.

Please Note: With the addition of New Game+, we have had to change the way save files work. Once you update your build, all of your save files will be converted to this new system. Save files from this version are not compatible with earlier versions of the game so, if you revert to an older build of the game, you will no longer be able to access your save files. If you for any reason need to access your old file, a copy of it can be found here:

C:\Users\windowsuser\AppData\LocalLow\Powersnake\Voidwrought

Along with all of this new content, we’ve added four new achievements for you to unlock:

 Hardcore - Beat the game on Hardcore Mode
 The Reborn - Survived the path of the Reborn
 The Harbinger - Survived the path of the Harbinger
 The Undone - Survived the path of the Undone


We’ve also included the following bug fixes in this update:

 Fixed an issue with the player dying and killing the Prince simultaneously.
 Wandering Fossil enemies no longer stick to the walls on death. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/e5fb48c1f80e60e3a71c845fe66db5ccb8280a13.png

To celebrate the release of New Game+, we’ve decided to run our first ever speedrunning competition! Follow the link here to find out more about how to enter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

Want to share your tips and tricks for tackling New Game+ with the Voidwrought community?

Then join our Discord and follow us on social media at @VoidwroughtGame!

notes.title: Nominate Voidwrought for Best Game on Steam Deck
notes.content:
The Old Gods may have been vanquished, but the Simulacrum has now turned its attention to an even loftier goal…

Getting nominated for a Steam Award!

We’re calling upon all Simulacrums to cast their vote for Voidwrought in the Steam Awards 2024. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/d3315da52017a189b8f0e902d6a56ce5951a4877.png

You’re free to choose to nominate Voidwrought for any of the categories in the Steam Awards, but we’d really appreciate it if you could nominate us for the Best Game on Steam Deck category!

The Best Game on Steam Deck category is designed to honour those games that were so good, you wanted to take them everywhere, so you grabbed your Steam Deck and did! Luckily, everything that made it endlessly playable at your desk got even better on the go.

So why have we chosen the Best Game on Steam Deck as our chosen category for Voidwrought?

While we will acknowledge that Voidwrought has an incredible soundtrack (masterminded by the insanely talented Jouni Valjakka), what we were able to achieve on the Steam Deck in such a short space of time is no less incredible.

Voidwrought was Steam Deck Verified within just two weeks of its launch. 

When a game is submitted for testing on the Steam Deck, it can be assigned one of three different badges depending on how it performs: Unsupported, Playable, or Verified. 

The Verified badge is only awarded to games that operate well on the Steam Deck without the need for the player to make manual adjustments and don’t present any significant problems when it comes to installation, performance, controls, and display.

Whereas it normally takes months of post-launch work and optimisation before a game is Steam Deck Verified, Voidwrought was considered by Valve to be of that high standard pretty much at launch, since we did not release any major patches or updates between launch and the point when Voidwrought received Verified status. Receiving Verified status is considered so important that SteamDeckHQ, the largest online resource dedicated to the Steam Deck, even makes a point of announcing every time a game is verified in their weekly highlights (and you can find Voidwrought’s special mention right here).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/66a69af65f8c1c9b96901aed74fd3c90e66d1e49.jpg

We were so excited when we heard that Voidwrought had been Steam Deck Verified so soon after its launch, since we put a lot of effort into making sure it ran well on the Steam Deck. notes.title: Voidwrought is Steam Deck Verified
notes.content:
Tendrils of Ichor have crept and oozed their way into our technology…

We’re thrilled to announce that Voidwrought is now officially Steam Deck Verified, which means you can continue to explore the ruins of The Gray City and uncover the mysteries of the First Civilization wherever you are!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/908cf0b4bcf860cf35abfa3d00aeb4cc3019e368.png

But what does being Steam Deck Verified mean?

When a game is submitted for testing on the Steam Deck, it can be assigned one of three different badges depending on how it performs. The Unsupported badge means that the game does not run properly on the Steam Deck and the Playable badge means that the game can be played on the Steam Deck, but the player may need to make some manual adjustments to the game for it to function correctly.

The Verified badge is only awarded to games that operate well on the Steam Deck without the need for the player to make manual adjustments and don’t present any significant problems when it comes to installation, performance, controls, and display.

We’re so proud to have achieved Steam Deck Verified status for Voidwrought within less than 2 weeks from launch!

notes.title: Excavation Journal I: The Commons
notes.content:
Delve into the ruins of The Gray City and uncover the secrets that lie buried within.

To fulfil their destiny, the Simulacrum must journey through the winding passageways and endless caverns of The Gray City, but they are not alone. They are reliant on an excavation team, who forge the path ahead and open up new avenues for exploration. Let us follow them on as they dig their way deeper and deeper into the abandoned recesses of this ancient civilization. 

Our first stop: The Commons.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

Carved into the bedrock, The Commons are the uppermost layer of the underground Gray City. These are the desolate living quarters of the once flourishing city, long since submerged beneath the now-frozen archipelago above. This was a place inhabited by the majority of the citizens, known as the commoners. The vast area has large derelict structures and carved tunnels connecting various squares, homes, and other areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/4cc139c4c26ad6c64f85d2bbf658efe94f8bf18a.gif

As this was once a residential district, some former citizens remain, now a husk of their former selves and damned to skulk their fallen city for eternity.

These reanimated inhabitants are draped in garments that have been worn down by the ravages of time. These ill-fitting rags serve as a poignant reminder of the district’s former glory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/828646772eae2e12f1a94cfc75a7661c35fa27d3.png

Want to discover what other horrors lurk in the depths and what untold truths lay dormant, waiting to be disturbed?

Then stay tuned for our second volume of the Excavation Journal.

For now, don’t forget to wishlist Voidwrought, join fellow Simulacrums in our Discord, and follow us on social media at @VoidwroughtGame!

notes.title: Introducing Voidwrought
notes.content:
The coming of the Red Star heralds a new age. 
Among the ruins of the First Civilization, a new form emerges from the ichor…

We’re thrilled to finally be able to share Voidwrought with the world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/


Take control of the newly-born Simulacrum in our upcoming 2D action-platformer Voidwrought. Delve into the thawing ruins of the First Civilisation to strike down the primeval gods that dwell there and absorb their power for yourself.

The Simulacrum is driven to collect Ichor, the blood of the gods, from the monstrosities who hoard it. It is your fate to conquer the old gods and collect the sacred Ichor that has empowered them since time immemorial.

In Voidwrought, you'll get to navigate levels, discover new empowering abilities, and take on a variety of challenging and horrific bosses. Customize your playstyle using powerful and enigmatic Artifacts, excavate the rubble of the Gray City, and restore a shrine for your loyal followers, who will pray for your success.

Voidwrought features dramatically realised hand-drawn locations, from the star-scorched Surface to the biomechanical Abandoned Expedition, inhabited by over 70 enemies and 10 formidable bosses.


[previewyoutube=RkVD-0fjr4Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Powersnake consists of 3 developers based in Sweden, sharing a love for all things touching on cosmic horror, passive souls-like narratives, and intriguing mysteries. Among us, we've worked on titles ranging from adventure games, city-builders, and 3D platformers to horse riding games. Regardless of genre we strive to put gameplay first, be it fluid combat, responsive movement, or engaging exploration.
Voidwrought is our love letter to the metroidvania genre and such greats like Hollow Knight, Castlevania, Crowsworn, and others.

We're also excited to announce that we'll be partnering with UK-based publisher Kwalee to release Voidwrought!
